deficiencies: Only 2 aircraft, both Pipistrel; too few to fit k on their own. Taurus is a self-launch motorglider (AR 18) and does not represent HS1-type trainers. Empty-weight definitions differ: Velis includes 24.8 kWh battery, Taurus only 4.75 kWh. Velis cert basis is from Wikipedia, not the TCDS. Battery mass is not separated, so structure and powertrain can't be told apart. Elektra Trainer (needs wing area) and Alpha Electro (no data) were excluded.

MTOW is set by regulation (472.5/600 kg UL/LSA caps), not structure, so it biases OEW/MTOW. Only RV-12 is Tier B; the other 9 come from Wikipedia specs citing Jane's or the manufacturer. Empty-weight definition given for only 2 of 10. V_NE missing for 3 (J-3, C162, Remos). Mixed materials (carbon, aluminium, steel tube/fabric); J-3 is a 1930s fabric design and an outlier. Shark gear type (retractable) is from my recollection, tier Z.

Most relevant to HS1 sizing, but only P2008 JC is Tier B; C150/C152 MTOW is Tier A from the TCDS, but their OEW is Jane's/POH via Wikipedia. Empty-weight definition given for only 2 of 9 (Hansa-3 is 'equipped for night ops', which inflates its ratio to 0.73). V_NE missing for Hansa-3 and Skipper. Super Cub (steel tube/fabric taildragger, 0.53) is a structural outlier. Hansa-3 needs the NAL/DGCA document to reach Tier A.

Mixes 2-seat aerobatic types (G115, T67, RV-7, Glasair) with 4-seat tourers (C172, AA-5, P2010, RV-10, DR400). Aerobatic +6/-3 g designs skew the wing factor, so tag them before fitting. RV-7/RV-10 are kit aircraft with builder-variable empty weight (manufacturer range midpoint used). V_NE missing for 4. Only 4 empty-weight definitions. DR400 is wood, a single-material outlier.

V_NE missing for 5 of 7. DA40 wing area is from the DA40 XLS spec block (same wing, but not NG-specific). Retractable (Commander) and fixed-gear types mixed; GA8 is a utility high-wing (0.55) unlike the tourers. Lancair ES is a kit aircraft. C182 TCDS values came from a summary of the PDF; verify against the PDF.

No Tier A/B values at all. Empty-weight definition only for BN-2 ('without avionics'). Cert basis missing for 5 of 6. DA42/DA62 composite diesels sit beside aluminium avgas twins; Islander/P2012 are fixed-gear commuters vs retractable C402/Seneca. Nacelle and second-engine installation weights are needed to compare these with singles.

Pressurized (TBM, Epic, PC-12) and unpressurized (Kodiak) mixed; pressurization changes fuselage weight a lot. No V_MO, no cert basis, no empty-weight definition anywhere; all values from Wikipedia citing brochures. PC-12 data is NG-era, not NGX; TBM data is TBM 900. Little relevance to HS1 beyond the regression range.
